name: zeffect_find_node_user_data_recursive
description: zEffect::FindNodeUserDataRecursive returns the current node's user data when present, otherwise scans listB children depth-first and returns the first non-null user data value.
known_limits: tier S verification was not attempted in this session. Functional coverage exercises direct and recursive discovery plus the runtime clone path that consumes the discovered display-instance pointer.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja reconstruction and assembly for 0x461ec0 validate the gwNodeGetUserData call, non-null user-data early return, signed listCountB loop, depth-first recursive listB traversal, and null return after all children miss.

The native smoke verifies grandchild-before-sibling discovery, sibling fallback after clearing the grandchild, root early return, and null return when the tree has no user data. zeffect_init_smoke covers the runtime clone path storing discovered effectGfxData.
